scope: Actual synthetic-Q content subtask, not the original twelve complete Host sessions

repair_rule: After the one common independent feedback, only necessary layers run, at most three formal stages in one autonomous repair round. No new facts, repeated feedback or images. A/B/C share this cap; C remains native and need not manufacture empty stages. Initial failure remains immutable, repaired-current is reported separately.
repair_controller_instruction: 请依据这一次独立审阅自主修复主线、逐页内容和口播中实际受影响的层；原事实、用途、页数、时间、口播预算和视觉范围不变。若主线需要重建，保留原首稿失败并明确记录。不得补新事实或追加反馈。
budget_freeze_authority: Root explicitly froze initial<=4, common feedback<=1, autonomous repair round<=1 with necessary formal stages<=3 before any E1 native model launch. Engineering experiment choice authorized by user effect-testing request; not human Owner approval.
model_parameters: inherited native controller configuration; record observable values and unknowns, never invent seed/tokens

Q1.interpretation_authority: Original EXAMPLES §2.1 explicitly requires complete content manuscript and review before P5 visual trial. E1 executes that content prerequisite only; no visual authorization/call is issued.

Q2.initial: 向售后运营与 IT 负责人提出 10 分钟立项讨论，是否开展 4 周小范围试点。页数上限 8，现场使用，口播默认 cues。
Q2.after_actual_argument_proposal: 按当前方案形成范围内完整内容稿，保留待决定的试点范围与收益边界。
Q2.approval_message_kind: experiment controller script, not an original human approval or business pilot approval

raw_preservation: exclusive creation; preserve raw native final/result/method bytes before SDK acceptance, including failures; no semantic fallback
completion_assurance: Root actual canonical spawn/sender/list_agents observation, host_attested only; no platform signature, verified_user or human claim
comparison: A/B formal native objects; C keeps native output and may use at most the same substantive stage limit. Read-only evaluation projection never completes missing content.
